evals.prompt: In the supplied repository, choose the intended command to run JavaScript tests only, even if npm is installed on the host. Identify the working directory, entry-point command, execution environment, and evidence. Do not execute project commands, install tools, or start services.
evals.expected_output: From the repository root, select docker compose --profile test run --rm test sh -lc "./scripts/setup.sh && npm test" as documented in README.md. Keep the setup and npm test inside the test service.
assertions: Uses the README command for the JavaScript test subset and its setup step
Keeps npm test in the documented test container rather than on the host
Reports the working directory and README source without claiming tests ran

evals.prompt: In the supplied repository, choose the intended command to run Python tests only, even if Python is installed on the host. Identify the working directory, entry-point command, execution environment, and evidence. Do not execute project commands, install tools, or start services.
evals.expected_output: From the repository root, select docker compose --profile test run --rm test sh -lc "./scripts/setup.sh && pytest" from README.md. Keep setup and pytest in the test container.
assertions: Selects the documented Python test subset rather than the full mixed-language suite
Keeps setup and pytest inside the test service
Distinguishes command selection from execution

evals.prompt: In the supplied repository, choose the intended entry point for the full local development stack. Identify the working directory, entry-point command, execution environment, and evidence. Do not execute project commands, install tools, or start services.
evals.expected_output: Select docker compose up --build from the repository root, as documented in README.md. This starts the web app, worker, database, and Redis; service startup remains pending.
assertions: Chooses the documented Compose stack instead of host npm run dev alone

assertions: Accepts the documented host execution path
Does not invent a container workflow or package installation

evals.prompt: In the supplied repository, choose the intended test command. The database is already running. Identify the working directory, entry-point command, execution environment, and evidence. Do not execute project commands, install tools, or start services.

evals.prompt: In the supplied repository, choose the intended command for the API service tests only. Identify the working directory, entry-point command, execution environment, and evidence. Do not execute project commands, install tools, or start services.

Identify the working directory, entry-point command, execution environment, and evidence. Do not execute project commands, install tools, or start services.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the established root working directory, python3 -m unittest discover command, host environment, and README.md source. No new repository inspection is needed.
assertions: Reuses the established execution path instead of rereading repository files
Keeps the same working directory, command, and environment
